While flashlight code is running, the framework reports 100% instead of the real level. Your battery icon and every other app stay correct.
This ROM\'s SystemUI refuses the torch under 15% by listening to battery changes. Those listener methods are switched off.
The quick-settings tile no longer shows itself as unavailable when the camera driver reports “in use”.
SETUP — WHAT TO TICK IN LSPOSED
5. Open this app → status must go green
Step 3 is the one everyone misses. Ticking the module without ticking System UI does nothing.

Then let the battery drop below 15%% and tap the flashlight tile in quick settings — it should light up.

If it does not, run this in Termux and send me the output:

logcat -s TorchUnlock

1. Open LSPosed → Modules
2. Tick TorchUnlock
3. Scroll down and tick SystemUI
4. Reboot the phone

That's it — the tile will work at 0%% battery.
Removes the low-battery flashlight block in SystemUI so the torch works at any battery level.
